purpose: Targeted E2 reader candidate: answer-loss training on source-separated synthetic values, with parent/candidate held-out evaluation. The earlier diagnostic localized the bottleneck to writer/reader encoding.

training.example_order: deterministic round-robin over sorted train cases
training.loss: response-only next-token cross entropy on answer plus EOS; prompt prefix masked
training.selection: lexical eligible records, limit 16, bank cap 16 units

evaluation.metric: exact stripped answer; retrieval selected IDs preserved; parent/candidate paired

decision_rule.accept: candidate held-out exact accuracy above parent and dev not below parent
decision_rule.reject: candidate held-out below parent or dev loss

retention: Keep parent extension, candidate extension, raw prompts/answers and all failures. No base copy or download.
claims: Exposed synthetic reader candidate; no generalization, calibrated confidence or task-action claim.
